speech.heard: Among 208 entities, 61 have fewer than 50% of people in cities. Yellow areas show entities at or above 50% urban while dark blue areas are mostly rural. Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. Among these entities, Kuwait is 100% urban while Papua and Guinea is 16%. Comparing urban shares, Japan is 92%, China is 66%, and India is 36%. So where does your country rank on this map?
differences: base.en: 'n' heard as 'and' after 'urban while papua'
